cells.gaps: Nothing says the social registry is linked to the national ID, or that benefits are paid digitally.
cells.note: Reassessed 2026-11-09: Decree 2024-073 makes households enrolled in the Registre Social eligible for both Tekavoul regular transfers and shock-response transfers, which answers question 3 and sets stage 4. The first pass had read it as the registry alone; nothing held links the registry to the national ID.
